Final implementation must independently verify original STL identity, scene face/material assignment and multi-view renders.
Original B portal has no separately modeled narrow roof coping; if side face is combined with beige portal facade it remains neutral across color boundary.
Main facade lower plinth is dark reddish brown but no separate added plinth geometry; retain cross-boundary wall polygons neutral.
Photograph right side is visible; preview left blank side is NOT photographed right side and remains neutral.
No addition of cars, air conditioners, signs, vegetation, grille detail or neighboring hall.
